description.value: A full-hookup RV resort in the Fraser Valley, directly off Trans-Canada Highway exit 109, with showers, laundry, and a championship golf course adjacent; all sites are serviced RV pads with no tent-only option mentioned.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides the primary evidence. Key amenities confirmed from the rates/amenities page: water at each site, washrooms with showers, laundry room, and free internet/electrical hookups. The OSM name 'Royalwood RV Resort' differs from the website's consistent 'Royalwood RV Park Resort'; OSM name is retained per rules but flagged. The privacy policy subpage lists a different street address (41050 Trans Canada Hwy.) from every other page (41172 Royalwood Dr.), suggesting a legacy/error page.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Royalwood RV Resort' but the website consistently uses 'Royalwood RV Park Resort' throughout all pages.
Privacy policy subpage lists a different address ('41050 Trans Canada Hwy., Chilliwack, BC') while all other pages confirm '41172 Royalwood Dr.' — likely a legacy error page.
No tent or hiker/biker site option is mentioned; the resort appears oriented exclusively toward RVs and fifth-wheels, which may disqualify it for cycling tourism listings.
Website copyright is 2008 but 2025/2026 rates are posted, suggesting minimal updates — some amenity details may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a full-hookup RV resort with no mention of hiker/biker sites, tent camping, or any cyclist-specific accommodation; it may not be a practical stop for self-supported touring cyclists, but the confirmed showers, laundry, and water could serve cyclists if walk-in or tent stays are permitted — that cannot be confirmed from available content.
enrichment_extras.notes: Local direct phone number 604-823-4111 also confirmed on website contact page (in addition to the toll-free 855-940-4111 matching OSM).

wow_evidence: all sites are serviced RV pads with no tent-only option mentioned
